problem_restatement.input: The V79 ZEC Donchian route failed largest-winner robustness and the V80 one-minute transfer screen failed its preregistered source-cadence bound before return replay.
problem_restatement.required_output: Test fixed, pre-existing causal strategy mechanisms on native fifteen-minute ZEC bars without tuning parameters or dropping ZEC from the roster.
problem_restatement.success_criteria: One exact family-side clears development, validation, and holdout at nominal and stress costs, remains positive without its largest winner, and can be implemented with runtime parity.

data_contract.gap_policy: reset rolling state and do not bridge missing native bars
data_contract.entry_timing: signal on one completed native fifteen-minute bar and enter at the next bar open

chronology.opening_rule: Run every fixed family-side in development, open validation only for complete development survivors, and open holdout only for complete validation survivors without changing parameters or direction.

support_criteria.multiple_comparison_rule: No ranking, best-of-grid selection, parameter edits, or direction changes; an exact family-side must independently pass every criterion in every opened partition.

falsifiers: native fifteen-minute coverage exceeds the missing-interval bound
no exact family-side clears development under both cost profiles
any passing result becomes non-positive without its largest winner
fewer than twelve trades resolve in any required partition

development_result.finding: No exact family-side passed both friction profiles. Every candidate with positive headline net PnL became negative after removing its largest winner; negative and sparse candidates also failed.
